pattern: Negative feedback is strongly tied to lower repeat purchase
evidence: repeat rate Negative 28.2% vs Neutral 50.6% vs Positive 72.0% (chi2=329, p=2.9e-72, Cramer's V=0.37)

pattern: Negative cases take about twice as long to resolve
evidence: mean resolution 18.1h (negative) vs 9.1h (non-negative); Cohen's d=1.90; resolution time alone separates them with AUC=0.91

pattern: Rating and CSAT are near-redundant measures of the same experience
evidence: Spearman rho(rating, CSAT)=0.97; both fall with resolution time (rho=-0.46)

pattern: No issue, channel, region, product or source is significantly worse than the rest
evidence: chi-square p-values Issue 0.33, Channel 0.27, Region 0.69, Product 0.79, Source 0.82; 314 cells scanned, 13 raw p<0.05 (expected 16 by chance), 0 survive FDR (min q=0.20)

pattern: Revenue and order count are unrelated to sentiment (negative feedback is not confined to low-value records)
evidence: mean revenue Negative INR 6,418 vs Positive INR 6,233 (Kruskal p=0.46); revenue is statistically uniform (KS p=0.50)
